title-group.article-title: Resistance training volume and hypertrophy in trained women

funding-group.funding-statement: This study received no external funding.

abstract.p: Forty trained women performed 10 or 20 weekly sets per muscle for 12 weeks.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Training volume is a key variable for hypertrophy [1].

sec.title: Participants
sec.p: Forty resistance-trained women (age 24 ± 3 years; training age 3.1 years) were randomized to 10 (n=20) or 20 (n=20) weekly sets per muscle.

sec.title: Outcomes
sec.p: Vastus lateralis muscle thickness was measured by ultrasound before and after 12 weeks.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Muscle thickness increased by 5.2% in the 20-set group and 3.9% in the 10-set group (difference 1.3%, 95% CI −0.4 to 3.0).
Strength gains did not differ between groups.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Doubling volume produced only a small additional gain of 1.3%.
